# vcp_vmware_images (Data Source)

List available VMware Cloud OS images/templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List VMware images in a location; optionally only GPU-capable ones.
data "vcp_vmware_images" "in_location" {
  location_id = 5
  gpu_only    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `gpu_only` (Boolean) Return only GPU-enabled images.
- `location_id` (Number) Filter images by location ID.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_hot_add` (Boolean)
- `hdd_gb` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_gpu_only` (Boolean)
- `memory_hot_add` (Boolean)
- `min_ram_mb` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `nic_hot_remove` (Boolean)
- `os_family` (String)
- `os_type` (String)
- `ssh_key_supported` (Boolean)
- `supported_gpu_model_ids` (List of Number)
